learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and understanding: Knowledge and understanding of the engineering disciplines specific to their specialization, at the level necessary to acquire the rest of the degree's competences, including notions of the latest advances.
Knowledge and understanding: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Engineering analysis: The ability to analyze complex products, processes and systems in their field of study; select and apply established analytical, computational and experimental methods appropriately and correctly interpret the results of such analyses.

Engineering analysis: The ability to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems in their specialty; appropriately select and apply established analytical, computational and experimental methods; recognize the importance of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial constraints.

Engineering projects: Ability to plan, design and develop complex products (parts, components, finished products, etc.), processes and systems in their specialty, that meet established requirements, including being aware of social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial aspects; as well as select and apply appropriate project methods.
Engineering projects: Project ability using advanced knowledge from their engineering specialty.

Research and innovation: Ability to conduct bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other information sources, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Research and innovation: Ability to consult and apply good practice and safety codes in their specialty.
Research and innovation: Ability and skill to design and conduct experimental research, interpret results and draw conclusions in their field of study.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, design and research and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct research specific to their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in their specialty.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the social, health and safety, environmental, economic and industrial implications of engineering practice.
Judgment: Ability to manage complex technical or professional activities or projects in their specialty, taking responsibility for decision-making.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers and people from other disciplines.
Continuous training: Ability to recognize the need for their own continuous training and to undertake this activity throughout their professional life independently.
Continuous training: Ability to keep up to date with developments in science and technology.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each of them, and making correct use of language, in writing.

syllabus_topics: Fluids for FLUIDIC power transmission applications (hydraulics and pneumatics).
Hydraulic valves (directional, pressure, flow, shut-off, proportional,...)
Design of hydraulic and/or pneumatic circuits for an industrial machine
teaching_methods: Development, drafting and presentation of reports, theses, audiovisual material, etc. related to projects/POPBLs, carried out individually or in teams
Individual study and work, tests, exams and/or control points
Completion of exercises individually and in teams
Classroom presentation in participatory classes, of concepts and procedures associated with the subjects

assessment_methods.method: Project-based evaluation (technical capability, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, delivered documentation, technical presentation and defense)
Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competences
Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and individual laboratory practices

assessment_rules: Continuous evaluation and project feedback is applied to several learning outcomes. Recovery for learning outcomes RGM325 and RGM326 will be carried out in a single individual written test. There are no recovery mechanisms for outcome RG302.
